summary.text: Quasi-supreme grandmaster sits between great grandmaster and supreme grandmaster on the attainment ladder. Holders are scarce even across thousands of years.

claims.text: Realm on a path climbs a fixed ladder from ordinary to supreme grandmaster. Quasi-supreme grandmaster is the quasi step between great grandmaster and supreme grandmaster.
It is not one of the five main levels (ordinary, master, grandmaster, great grandmaster, and supreme grandmaster); those main levels are the rungs the quasi steps sit between.

Those able to attain quasi-supreme grandmaster are scarce, with few produced even in thousands of years. Above them, supreme grandmasters are rarer still: refinement path has only three across history.

The reason the step is “quasi” is that supreme grandmaster requires surpassing the foundation of the whole world, creating something out of nothing, and achieving a new innovation. Completely inheriting a predecessor’s true meaning can raise attainment to quasi-supreme grandmaster without going further to surpass the world’s foundation in that path. Quasi-supreme refinement path attainment is already enough to look down proudly on refinement path Gu Immortals across the five regions, and it is treated as reaching a peak height with the most abundant foundation.

After Fang Yuan absorbs Long Hair Ancestor’s refinement path true meaning, his refinement path attainment soars to quasi-supreme grandmaster in one step. With that height, mortal Gu recipes reveal their profundities at a glance and can be raised to an optimal level with a thought, Immortal Gu recipes clarify under concentration, and even complex rank eight recipes can be pondered without erroneous thoughts. In refinement path history there are only three supreme grandmasters; with quasi-supreme grandmaster attainment, Fang Yuan places himself in the historical top ten by refinement path attainment level.

Experts at refinement path quasi-supreme grandmaster level can be counted on one’s fingers since ancient times. Those who surpassed that level amount to only three people in the whole of history. That attainment is named as the main reason Fang Yuan can hold a fifty percent success rate when refining myriad self Immortal Gu with Lang Ya Sect’s help and luck from Giant Sun’s true inheritance.
The full ladder is on Attainment. Neighboring steps include great grandmaster and supreme grandmaster. Dao marks and how they relate to attainment are on Dao Marks and Attainment.
